system.name: OTPNet
system.one_liner: ODE-inspired tuning-free proximal network for remote sensing image fusion, derived from two proximal optimization problems (pan-sharpening shown).

content.variant_note: degradation model, a boxed derivation chain of proximal updates and the network that draws the same update, in three grey panels
content.argues: The fusion network is not hand-designed: it follows from the degradation model through two proximal optimization problems and a high-order ODE update.
content.subject: Degradation model, boxed proximal-update equations in two mirrored branches, and the image-node network that implements the same update.

elements.name: PAN / HR-MS / LR-MS
elements.role: the three images of the degradation model: panchromatic, high-resolution multispectral and low-resolution multispectral
elements.drawn_as: three image tiles of different size, each with its symbol and tensor shape written beneath

elements.name: S
elements.role: spectral response that maps the HR-MS image to the PAN image
elements.drawn_as: thick labelled arrow carrying a small inset of coloured response curves

elements.name: D↓
elements.role: downsampling from the HR-MS image to the LR-MS image

elements.name: P = HS / L = DH
elements.role: observation models of the PAN and LR-MS images
elements.drawn_as: two blue-outlined rounded boxes at the left, top and bottom

elements.name: min_H ||P − HS||² + R_P(H) / min_H ||L − DH||² + R_L(H)
elements.role: the two optimization problems, a data term plus a regularizer each
elements.drawn_as: two wide blue-outlined boxes at the right, top and bottom

elements.name: H_P^{k-1} = SᵀP / H_L^{k-1} = DᵀL
elements.role: back-projection of the PAN and LR-MS observations
elements.drawn_as: two blue-outlined boxes on the left, second row from the top and from the bottom

elements.name: F^k = prox_{R_P,γ}(H^{k-1}) − H_P^{k-1}
elements.role: proximal update for the PAN problem
elements.drawn_as: wide blue-outlined box in the second row

elements.name: G^k = prox_{R_L,γ}(αF^k + βH^{k-1}) − H_L^{k-1}
elements.role: proximal update for the LR-MS problem, fed by F^k
elements.drawn_as: wide blue-outlined box in the second row from the bottom

elements.name: H^k = H^{k-1} + λ^k (G^k + F^k)
elements.role: update of the fused image from both proximal terms
elements.drawn_as: central blue-outlined box where the top and bottom branches meet

elements.name: Inputs / Output
elements.role: mark the left and the right end of the network row
elements.drawn_as: rotated words at the left and right edges of panel (c)

elements.name: − and + nodes
elements.role: subtract and add image tiles inside the network
elements.drawn_as: small circles with a minus (two) or a plus (two); one line hops over another with an arc

lessons.what_to_learn: For algorithm-unrolling work, show the same update three times (as the physical model, as boxed equations in two mirrored branches that converge on the update, and as a network of labelled images joined by sum and difference nodes) using identical symbols so each image maps to an equation.

summary: OTPNet is an ODE-inspired, tuning-free proximal network for remote sensing image fusion; the figure shows the pan-sharpening task, which fuses a high-resolution panchromatic image with a low-resolution multispectral one. Three grey panels tell the story. (a) shows the degradation model: the PAN image comes from the high-resolution multispectral image through a spectral response S, and the low-resolution image through downsampling D. (b) lays out the optimization as blue-outlined equation boxes in two mirrored branches, one per problem, whose proximal updates F^k and G^k converge on the update of H^k. (c) draws the same update as a network of real image patches joined by subtraction and sum nodes, from inputs P, H^(k-1), L to output H^k.
summary_zh: OTPNet 的示意图：三块灰色面板依次给出全色锐化的退化模型 (a)、用方框公式排成上下两支并汇入 H^k 更新的 ODE 优化步骤 (b)，以及用真实遥感图块加减法节点画出的同一更新网络 (c)。
notes: No paragraph of the paper text mentions the figure, so roles come from the caption, the abstract and the equations in the figure itself; the wiring of the middle + node and of the vertical double-headed arrows in (c) is read from the drawing. The text layer carries circled digits that are not visible in the print. The figure is a mechanism-style diagram in the index but has no steps, so it is kept as concept-schematic plus model-anatomy as in the prior.
